messages:
Marisol: Quick check-in on Nimbus account — grabbing the weekly churn/health snapshot. TL;DR: tokens up WoW ~18%, QoQ ~43%. Spend +12% WoW. p95 latency up ~40ms, errors ticked to 4.8% (mostly 429s).
Lina: thanks — any specific routes or keys spiking the 429s?
Marisol: looks concentrated on /v1/generate (key id k-nimbus-prod-2). Burstiness at 11:02–11:14 UTC yesterday.
datadog-bot: [ALERT] nimbus-prod - 429 rate exceeded threshold (5m avg = 4.6%). See dashboard: https://dd.example.com/d/nimbus/requests
Ethan: I pulled traces — KV-cache hit drops during heavy parallel streams. Likely client-side concurrency > recommended.
Priya: can we confirm model variant? If they're on a higher mem model it could raise per-token latency.
Marisol: they upgraded to rdx-2-large about 3 weeks ago (QoQ change). We saw QoQ tokens +43% which suggests feature expansion.
Noah: flagged as potential renewal risk if cost spike isn't addressed. Can we propose a pairing session to optimize batching / caching?
Lina: propose: 1) quick config audit (client batch size, concurrency), 2) enable prefix caching on routes, 3) suggest fallback to rdx-2-medium for non-critical routes.
Priya: I can draft a small patch for their SDK usage. Suggest adding this call recommendation:
```
// client-side: set concurrency to 4
const client = new RedwoodClient({concurrency:4, batchWindowMs:25})
```
Marisol: nice. Can we also run a quick query to show token distribution by route? I'm pasting the BigQuery we used earlier:
```
SELECT route, COUNT(*) as reqs, SUM(tokens) as tokens, AVG(latency_ms) as avg_ms
FROM `redwood.telemetry.events`
WHERE account_id = 'acct_nimbus' AND _PARTITIONTIME BETWEEN TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()
GROUP BY route
ORDER BY tokens DESC
LIMIT 20;
```
Ethan: running the query now — will clip top 5 and share numbers.
Ethan: results: /v1/generate = 62% tokens, /v1/embeddings = 18%, others small. Top key = k-nimbus-prod-2 (78% of calls).
Marisol: ok — action plan: Lina to send config audit checklist to Nimbus CSM, Priya to prepare SDK note and fallback guidance, Ethan to propose autoscale tweak and cache policy, Noah to prep cost/runbook for renewal discussion.
Noah: ping me when we have the numbers + proposed cost delta. I'll schedule renewal prep with the AE.
Lina: one more thing — recommend scheduling a 30m enablement session for their devs this week. Availability: Thu 16:00 UTC or Fri 09:30 UTC.
Marisol: I'll propose Thu 16:00 UTC. If they accept, we'll include a short demo: batching + prefix-cache + model routing.
Priya: will draft slides + short code snippets.
Marisol: thanks team. I'll update the ticket: https://tickets.example.com/RED-4321 with the plan and assign tasks. Closing this thread — will report back after the enablement. :thumbsup:
